before_metrics.comment: first realized-growth attribution on broad universe using the new exp-20260605-007 asset.

change_summary: Joined exp-20260605-007 companyfacts revenue YoY growth (PIT asof<=signal_day) to warehouse OHLCV, 71518 obs across 3 windows. Growth quintile long-short 20d +0.52pct gross (t=0.92, insignificant, net negative); ladder non-monotonic U-shaped (Q1 low-growth highest at +2.57pct); late_strong window inverts (-2.58pct). ret20 double-sort residual +0.30pct t=0.59 (insignificant). Caught and fixed a residual t-stat flaw: first run t-tested only 5 ret20-band means (spurious t=3.29); corrected to daily within-band series (n=64) -> t=0.59. No robust growth edge raw or momentum-conditional.

gate2.name: pit_growth_join
gate2.note: signal uses most recent companyfacts row with asof_date<=signal_day

hypothesis: On the broad 1446 universe, higher realized revenue YoY growth (companyfacts, PIT) out-returns lower growth over 10/20d and is incremental over ret20 (double-sort).
next_evidence_needed: Test fundamental growth at earnings-event frequency (filing date) not daily, combined with quality (margin/cash-conversion); a long-only top-quintile framing is cheaper but the U-shaped ladder (Q1 high) argues against a simple top rule. The companyfacts asset itself remains the right clean replacement for yfinance eps_estimate.

prediction.outcome_vs_prediction: matched: raw insignificant + ret20-conditional residual insignificant; stale-quarterly + one-window-inverts both present.
